purpose: Select a lossless, symmetry-correct, Ryzen-feasible neural representation without repeating the old raw-exact versus semantic-lossy comparison or using V1-generated offline targets as the sole selection criterion.
frozen_action_abstraction_during_3c: R7.5.4A control action abstraction; representation experiments may not change legal action slots or sizing semantics

old_paired_corpus_interpretation.forbidden_use: A candidate may not be rejected solely because it fits V1-generated paired targets worse after enforcing a mathematically valid game symmetry.

must_preserve: flop versus turn versus river chronology
all pairwise same-suit relations among visible cards
must_quotient: order of Hero's two simultaneous private cards
order of the three simultaneous flop cards
card_state_contract.preferred_wire_semantics: rank tokens plus role/visibility plus label-free pairwise same-suit relation; no physical suit ID is a neural semantic category

H0_FIXED_V1.description: V1 exact state as control with GRU history length honored and true-HU dead-seat canonicalization; no semantic enrichment.
H0_FIXED_V1.purpose: Measure the value of fixing confirmed V1 defects before adding knowledge.

H1_RELATIONAL_EXACT.description: H0 plus lossless suit-label-invariant/permutation-invariant exact card representation based on ranks, roles and pairwise same-suit relations.
H1_RELATIONAL_EXACT.purpose: Test true card symmetry with a representation designed for relational suits instead of post-hoc remapped rank+suit IDs.

H2_RELATIONAL_EXACT_STRUCTURED_HISTORY.description: H1 plus structured public history: actor-relative role, street, exact action type, forced flag, normalized paid/resulting commitment/pot-before/pot-after; packed/masked recurrent encoding.
H2_RELATIONAL_EXACT_STRUCTURED_HISTORY.purpose: Remove V1 action-history aliasing while retaining lossless exact current state.

H3_HYBRID_EXACT_SEMANTIC.description: H2 plus corrected invariant poker semantics; exact relational card state remains present and no exact information is replaced by buckets.
semantic_requirements: board rank/suit texture without physical suit IDs
exclusive made-hand category and objective relation-to-board features
objective straight/flush/backdoor/combo draw features with street validity
postflop lineage/opportunity facts such as c-bet/donk/probe only when derivable unambiguously
correct pairwise effective-stack/SPR features rather than dead-seat minimum

H4_HYBRID_CAPACITY.description: H3 with additional nonlinear capacity; admitted only after H3 structural correctness and resource screen pass.
H4_HYBRID_CAPACITY.purpose: Test the hypothesis that capacity formerly spent relearning symmetries can be reinvested in useful poker complexity within the Ryzen envelope.

properties: turn/river swap remains distinguishable when state differs
exact turn/river perturbations remain distinguishable unless globally suit-isomorphic
trailing history padding has exactly zero effect
33pct versus 50pct sizing distinguishable in structured-history candidates
forced blind versus voluntary bet distinguishable in structured-history candidates
c-bet/donk/probe lineage differences distinguishable when applicable
no physical suit number exposed as semantic category
no villain hole card in observation
C++ serialization and Python decoding parity
phase_0_structural_gate.failure_rule: Any failed mandatory property blocks that candidate from phases 1/2. Thresholds are not weakened after observing outputs.

phase_1_offline_diagnostic.seed_derivation: low 31 bits of first 32 SHA256 bits for labels R7.5.3C:FIT:0..2
phase_1_offline_diagnostic.selection_rule: Diagnostic only. Catastrophic information loss, numerical failure or infeasible runtime may block a candidate. Worse imitation of V1-generated targets alone cannot reject a symmetry-correct candidate.

phase_2_candidate_specific_end_to_end.training_seed_derivation: low 31 bits of first 32 SHA256 bits for labels R7.5.3C:E2E:0..1
phase_2_candidate_specific_end_to_end.evaluation_seed_derivation: low 31 bits of first 32 SHA256 bits for labels R7.5.3C:EVAL:0..1
metrics: frozen R7.4-style advantage-fit diagnostics per iteration
mean positive regret proxy / candidate-native convergence diagnostics
candidate pairwise cross-play where mechanically valid
phase_2_candidate_specific_end_to_end.anti_overclaim: No phase-2 proxy is called exact exploitability unless an independently frozen best-response method with uncertainty is implemented.

phase_3_capacity_reinvestment.admission: H4 runs only if H3 passes phase 0 and is not already resource-infeasible.
phase_3_capacity_reinvestment.rule: H4 is accepted over H3 only for a material strategic/convergence benefit without violating any resource band in either domain.

hard_requirements: train/runtime contract capable of exact identity
preference_order: strategic/convergence evidence from candidate-specific end-to-end phase
offline V1-target imitation as secondary diagnostic only
winner_rules.tie_break: Choose the smallest/fastest candidate among candidates with no material strategic difference.
winner_rules.no_clear_winner: R7.5.3C remains BLOCKED; do not authorize R8 production training and do not silently default to old V1 merely because it was the historical control.

evidence_inheritance.engine_rules_dealing_icm: retain unless a demonstrated dependency invalidates them
evidence_inheritance.old_action_sizing_run: may finish as baseline; if representation winner changes, representation-dependent sizing/stability evidence must be rerun or explicitly bridged
evidence_inheritance.r8_production: blocked until 3C winner and representation-dependent revalidation are closed
